learning_extracted: The eligibility-trace underflow was the SHARED proximate cause behind six consecutive MECH-357 non-adjudications: the INTACT arm was functionally lesioned exactly where the scoring window opened (scaffold floor annealed to 0 as the trace underflowed), while whole-run readiness aggregates kept reporting the gate engaged at 1.0. Scoring-window-scoped gate_live checks (this run's C1 shape) are the durable countermeasure and should be standard on any trace-consuming Stage-H DV.

mech357_n_freeze_noop makes the repair's mechanism legible: e.g. seed 42 INTACT logged 29446 freeze/no-op ticks the old rule would have charged as decay against 1091 genuine failed-attempt decays -- a 27:1 spurious-decay load removed without touching learn/leak rates.

Seed 44's window median (0.033; 24x below its own peak; decay:credit 5.9:1, the highest of the six cells) shows the repaired trace still sags substantially where directed attempts fail often. The C1 floor (0.01) was set ~22 orders above the failure mode, so this is comfortably a PASS, but the retest's graded DV should treat trace magnitude as informative, not binary.

The stage0_forced_feed_lights_zgoal readiness gate cleared exactly at threshold (2/3 seeds) in both arms -- one seed per arm never lit z_goal above 0.4 at Stage 0. Not load-bearing here, but a recurring soft spot in this scaffolded-onboarding family worth watching in the retest.
